layout.body:
Springvale College Daily
A new exhibition opens Friday, October 15, at 4:00 P.M. in the college art museum. Featuring the senior projects of art majors, the show offers free admission for students and alumni and runs through November 30.
Refreshment sales will support future campus cultural programs.

questions.stem: What is the primary purpose of the newspaper article?

options.A: To announce the opening of a new college art museum building
options.B: To remind senior art majors to submit their senior projects for judging
options.C: To announce a student art show at Springvale College
options.D: To ask for donations to support cultural programs at Springvale College

questions.analysis: What is the primary purpose of the newspaper article? 解析： 文章的核心目的是发布一则通知。首句 “A new exhibition opens...” 直接点明了事件 —— 一个新展览的开幕。紧接着的 “Featuring the senior projects of art majors” 说明了展览的内容是艺术专业学生的毕业作品。因此，整篇文章的主要目的就是宣布 Springvale 学院将举办一场学生艺术展。 选项分析： A 选项错误：文章提到展览地点是 “in the college art museum”，并未提及新馆落成。 B 选项错误：展览内容是 “senior projects”，说明作品已经完成并展出，并非提醒学生提交。 D 选项错误：文章最后提到 “Refreshment sales will support future campus cultural programs”，这只是一个补充信息，并非文章的主要目的。

questions.stem: What does the article suggest about entrance fees for the exhibition?

options.A: They will be different for students as compared to alumni.
options.B: They will include free refreshments at the event.
options.C: They will be waived for students and alumni.
options.D: They will go toward buying new artwork for the museum.

questions.analysis: What does the article suggest about entrance fees for the exhibition? 解析： 文章明确提到 “the show offers free admission for students and alumni”。“free admission” 意为 “免费入场”，与选项 C 中的 “be waived”（被免除）意思完全一致。 选项分析： A 选项错误：文章表明学生和校友都是免费的，没有区别。 B 选项错误：文章提到 “refreshment sales”，说明茶点是出售的，并非免费包含在内。 D 选项错误：茶点销售的收入将用于支持未来的校园文化项目，并未提及门票收入用于购买艺术品。
